records.summary: Two-slide healthy deck: on-slide shapes, 20pt body, alt-text image, good contrast.
Agenda deck with CJK font name planted, centred closing slide, alt-text image.

One defect per slide: off-slide shape, overflowing box, overlap, 8pt text, grey-on-white contrast, blank slide, three leftover placeholders on slide 7 (Click to add title / TODO / Lorem ipsum -> 3 unfinished_placeholder findings), corrupted PNG, hyperlink to missing slide, alt-less image, CJK kinsoku violation. Totals: error=4, warning=8, info=1.
Truncated OOXML zip; expected to fail python-pptx open (positive sample for structure_anomaly).

Slide 1 is a well-typeset CJK page (YaHei, full-width punctuation, proper CJK-Latin spacing) and reports 0 issues. Slide 2 triggers 2 cjk_typography findings: a line-start comma (kinsoku_line_start) and a half-width comma after CJK text (halfwidth_punct). Glued CJK-Latin with no space is treated as a style choice and is not flagged.
Full-bleed background, native table, clustered-column chart, 40-square heatmap, and a grouped oval stack.  Rich but valid; intended to stress false-positive rate.

16:9, Microsoft YaHei, native 3x2 table. Same content, different authoring. Expected renderer differences: (1) LibreOffice falls back to a metric font (e.g. Noto Sans CJK) when Microsoft YaHei is absent, slightly shifting line breaks vs PowerPoint. (2) PowerPoint renders the native table with its own theme styling; LibreOffice and WPS apply their own table borders, so column widths may reflow by a few pixels. (3) The 4:3 flattened deck has no native table, so all three renderers should agree, but the rectangles may not align to a real grid in master-view editing. (4) WPS on Linux may substitute a different CJK font than Windows PowerPoint, altering glyph metrics.

4:3, Calibri, table flattened to rectangles. The title text box was authored at the 16:9 width (~12.03 in) and overflows the 4:3 canvas (10 in) by ~2 in, which is a genuine offslide_object finding rather than a false positive.
